description: Broadcasts a multiple-choice question and tallies live answers. Has adaptive per-student difficulty (off by default; teacher-toggleable automatic/manual), a correctness streak and opt-in scoreboard per student, live mid-session editing (replace the current question, skip ahead, or extend the timer) via a teacher_command control attribute, a per-class identity (class_code/class_name) so more than one class can run on the same machine without their data mixing, and persistence -- a class's identity, roster, and question bank survive the process exiting, and can be resumed later. Install math-student alongside it to see the tally move.
author: prackoreal
